notes:
Lead source: inbound from blog post on LLM for commerce (signup form). Early SMB, technical buyer is Head of Product (Maya Lin). Wants self-serve first, low friction.

Key constraints / asks (verbatim and paraphrase):
- "We need something that feels as good as GPT for customer answers but costs < 40% of current spend."
- Fast startup: use hosted API; no on-prem now. Public cloud ok.
- Model flexibility: wants to compare Llama 2/3 13B -> Mistral 7B/8x -> Qwen small variants. Curious about quantized options if Redwood supports them.
- Primary workloads: 60% chat support (short context), 30% product search/semantic ranking (embeddings + rerank), 10% nightly summarization batch jobs.
- Latency target: P95 < 600ms for chat; throughput modest (200 rps peak). Cost sensitivity: high (monthly budget target ~ $4k-$8k).
- Quality signals: cares about hallucination rate on SKU lookup and instruction-following for policy responses.
- Routing/fallback: wants automatic fallback to cheaper model when non-critical answers, and a high-quality model for policy/checkout flows.
- Security: needs SSO for team, audit logs for prompts, and retention controls. No data residency requirement now but may revisit.

What we recommended (AE/SE notes):
- Start with hosted_api; set up two model routes: 
  * route-high: Llama-3-13B-like or Mistral-instruct-7B for policy/checkout (higher quality),
  * route-low: Qwen-lite or Llama-2-13B-q8 for casual chat to save costs.
- Use Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and prefix caching to reduce token costs.
- Suggest sampling 200 prompts from their corpus to run quick evals (we can help run).
- Provide cost/latency matrix for top 4 variants (include per-token estimate) — ACTION: Diego to prepare examples, Alyssa to send matrix by 2024-12-08.
